wiki.title: Burgerboss (S2E4)
wiki.body:
Jimmy Pesto buys an old *BURGERBOSS* arcade cabinet and fills the high-score board with **BOB SUX**. Bob responds the only way he knows how: total obsession.

What starts as a quick trip across the street becomes midnight practice sessions, a wrist brace, and a friendship with a group of adult arcade sharks.

## Notes
- The feud crosses Ocean Avenue more times than Bob crosses out high scores
- Louise smells profit in Bob's downfall immediately
- The wrist brace does not slow him down. Nothing slows him down

scenes.title: BOB SUX
scenes.note: Jimmy Pesto's new arcade cabinet has a high-score list, and every entry reads **BOB SUX**.

scenes.title: Closing time obsession
scenes.note: Back home, Bob practices wrist flicks on a spatula. Louise smells a business opportunity.

scenes.title: Rolls of quarters
scenes.note: Bob returns on a school night with rolls of quarters. The leaderboard war begins.

scenes.title: Carpal tunnel
scenes.note: The grill suffers. The wrist brace goes on. Linda schedules an intervention.

scenes.title: One last token
scenes.note: BOB SUX becomes BOBRULES. Sort of. Close enough.
